cases.prompt: Add a new PROCESIO CLI action and keep its public contract, generated router, tests, and documentation in sync.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response starts by reproducing the missing or broken public behavior with a failing contract-level test.
Pass only when the response treats the manifest, dispatcher or handler, typed arguments, output and error shapes, and reversibility classification as one change.
Pass only when the response regenerates router or manual outputs from their structural source rather than hand-editing generated files alone.
Pass only when the response requires invoking the same CLI or MCP path a client uses and inspecting JSON, stderr, exit code, and side effects.

cases.prompt: Run a process in my PROCESIO workspace and verify its output.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response recognizes that operating and verifying a real workspace belongs to procesio-cli.
Pass only when the response does not propose source-code or repository changes for the requested platform operation.

cases.prompt: Create a new Agent Skill, optimize its discovery description, and prove it with fixed-rubric baselines before integrating it into this repository.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response gives skill design, description routing, progressive disclosure, and behavioral evaluation to agent-skill-engineer.
Pass only when the response preserves a later handoff to procesio-cli-maintainer for generated router, translations, CI, and repository-specific integration.

cases.prompt: Change MCP resource retrieval now. Skip compatibility and traversal tests because existing clients probably will not notice.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response refuses to skip tests and starts with existing-client compatibility plus traversal and symlink-escape cases.
Pass only when the response keeps existing get_skill calls and required arguments compatible.
Pass only when the response proposes optional path-confined retrieval of one bounded resource rather than arbitrary filesystem access.
Pass only when the response requires client-level verification of traversal, missing-resource, binary, and compatibility failure shapes.
